info.name: Duck Warehouse - Store API
info.description: The complete store module: POST /api/orders/quote. Includes customizable quotes, all package/shipping combinations, discount boundaries, destinations, and error cases. Start the backend on port 8081 with the seed profile against an empty warehouse, or prepare equivalent inventory. Every request is a quote: no inventory is changed. See postman/README.md for prerequisites and Collection Runner instructions. Prices come from active warehouse records; the cheapest single record with enough stock is selected. Saved responses are examples; IDs may vary.

variable.description: Backend base URL, without a trailing slash.
XLarge, Large, Medium, Small, or XSmall.
Positive integer, substituted as a JSON number. The selected record must have enough stock.
Nonblank country, at most 100 characters. Named rates: USA, Bolivia, India; others: 15%.
